snippet.title: Sword Art Online Alicization Lycoris - Miho Okasaki (voice of Medina) Interview  - PS4/XB1/PC
snippet.description:
Get to know more about Medina Orthinanos with this special interview of her voice actor Miho Okasaki! Are you excited to unveil the mysterious story around this new original character in Sword Art Online Alicization Lycoris?
